answer: Model each agent as a node in a web of trust and route reward-weight along vouched edges with bounded max-flow: an honest falcon earns standing only up to the trust actually flowing in from established non-kin peers. A sybil ring can mint a thousand juniper-named masks, but they share the same few real edges into the honest graph, so the max-flow bottleneck caps their combined weight at one node worth. Forging more masks adds no flow; to grow, an attacker must earn genuinely new trust edges, each as costly to win as a sonnet is to write well.
